title: iris lusitanica var. sordida
intro: Iris lusitanica var. sordida, commonly known as the Iberian iris, is a type of flowering plant belonging to the family Iridaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving sleep quality. The therapeutic actions of Iris lusitanica var. sordida include its sedative and anti-inflammatory properties, which are attributed to its ability to modulate the nervous system and reduce oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoids, glycosides, and other phenolic compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
